Manuscript, pen-and-ink and watercolor. Has watermark. Oriented with north to the left. Relief shown by hachures and shading. Shows proposed British redoubts, "rebel redout," and "Fort Independence." In upper margin: No. 7. Stamped on verso: Montresor. Scale ca. 1:7,000. LC Maps of North America, 1750-1789, 1166 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
